README: Every blocking call (fs.*Sync, child_process execSync/execFileSync/spawnSync, and the same names imported on their own) in desktop/src/main/** is listed here.
Enforced by desktop/tests/main-blocking-calls.test.ts: a call not listed here fails; an entry that no longer matches fails as stale, so this list only shrinks.

Key = file (relative to src/main) + fn (the enclosing named functions, outermost first; anonymous callbacks registered like ipcMain.handle(IPC.X, ...) show as handle(IPC.X)) + call (the callee as written). count = how many such calls.
Prefer making a call async (fs.promises, async child_process) over adding an entry. Add one only for startup/shutdown-only code or something tiny a user triggers rarely, with a reason.
unreviewed-hot-path-candidate = seeded 2026-09-23 from the code as it stood, not yet judged; converting these to async is welcome — then delete the entry.
